channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Rep. Luna urges background checks for Congress and staff
item.description: Rep. Anna Paulina Luna, R-Fla., cited new details about former Rep. Eric Swalwell to push for mandatory background checks on lawmakers and aides.

item.title: DOJ official: Restoring gun rights is 'very American'
item.description: U.S. Pardon Attorney Ed Martin praised a new Justice Department process that lets certain individuals barred from owning guns apply to have their rights restored.

item.title: Trump backs Jennifer Balkcom as GOP nominee after Edwards exits
item.description: President Trump endorsed North Carolina state Rep. Jennifer Balkcom, who became the GOP nominee for U.S. House after Rep. Chuck Edwards ended his re-election bid.

item.title: Socialist insurgency targets pro-Israel Democrats in Florida primary
item.description: DSA-backed Oliver Larkin challenges Rep. Jared Moskowitz in Florida's 25th District, intensifying the Democratic Party's internal left-center conflict.
